summary: No held name had a thesis-breaking news event today. Nothing in the news input contradicts the VRSN, IEF or VOO buys: Q3 was already reported (VRSN 8-K 2.02 and 10-Q on 10-22, next estimate 2027-02-04, per L2) and Wedbush raised its VRSN PT to $367 from $351. Watch items: DA Davidson cut its DPZ PT to $382 from $423 (Buy kept) on a position already 1% under cost; BTC/USD fell to about $80k (position -4.6%), with the analyst downside target of $72-76k, which would be near the position's invalidation (10% under fill, about $75.3k); IDXX earnings are about 5 trading days out. The biggest corporate news was EQT's all-stock deal for RRC, a name the agent does not hold (shadow book only). The tape was otherwise quiet for held names.
upcoming: Fed decision this week is the main risk for the IEF, BND and VOO adds (two-way duration risk, hawkish outcome is the stated invalidation for IEF and BND). Oil near $117 with Iran headlines (El-Erian warns of $150) and mega-cap earnings plus AI-bubble worries weigh on the index sleeves. Held-name events: IDXX earnings estimated 11-02 (7 calendar days, exactly 5 trading days, so on the edge; estimate approximate); CARG 11-05 (outside the window, but a new buy near it would be high risk; note CART/Instacart, which is exploring a sale per The Information on 10-23 and halted differential-pricing tests today, is a different company from the held CARG); KR next 12-03, with electronic-shelf-label pricing scrutiny a minor sentiment item; WMT 11-19 (an unread 8-K 8.01 from 10-23, probably routine, plus holiday events 11-12 to 12-02); DPZ next estimate 2027-02-22 (Texas marketplace-tax change after a Domino's challenge is mildly positive); MSCI estimate of 10-27 is stale (reported 10-20), and the new index exclusion rules and Indonesia status are index-business items. Not held but on the calendar: INCY, EXLS, LOGI 10-27; CALX, CVS, GRMN 10-28; AAPL (product event 10-28, earnings 10-29 or 11-02), HWM, BDC, BJRI, LNG 10-29; MSTR reports 10-29 after the close (read-through for BTC). RRC: an 8-K with items 1.01/7.01/8.01/9.01 was filed 10-26 for the EQT merger (0.987 EQT share per RRC share, pro forma EV above $50B), so the 10-28 earnings estimate is probably superseded; this resolves the open L2 question for RRC as a deal event, not an earnings read. SMG's 10-16 8-K 5.02 has aged out of the window and is still unread. Lessons: L2 applied, with earnings dates for every held name and the VRSN, MSCI and RRC dates checked against filings. L1 not relevant to news.
